generation_settings.grammar:
array ::= "[" space ( value ("," space value)* )? space "]"
boolean ::= ("true" | "false")
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
decimal-part ::= [0-9]{1,16}
edits ::= "[" space edits-item ("," space edits-item){0,15} space "]"
edits-item ::= "{" space edits-item-changes-kv "," space edits-item-node-kv space "}"
edits-item-changes ::= object
edits-item-changes-kv ::= "\"changes\"" space ":" space edits-item-changes
edits-item-node-kv ::= "\"node\"" space ":" space string
edits-kv ::= "\"edits\"" space ":" space edits
integral-part ::= [0] | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15}
null ::= "null"
number ::= ("-"? integral-part) ("." decimal-part)? ([eE] [-+]? integral-part)?
object ::= "{" space ( string ":" space value ("," space string ":" space value)* )? space "}"
root ::= "{" space edits-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
string ::= "\"" char* "\""
value ::= object | array | string | number | boolean | null
